name: Textio
summary: Writing guidance for recruiting and performance management, including job posts and reviews.
description: Textio helps recruiting and HR teams write job posts and helps managers write performance reviews and feedback that is growth-oriented and free of biased language. It also provides interview intelligence. A free trial account can be created, and paid packages are designed with sales; no public prices are listed. Its products are Textio Feedback, Textio Recruiting and Lavalier Interview Intelligence.
